description: Giving People a Second Life! We are thrilled to welcome back Rishi Krishna, the visionary Founder and CEO of Symbionic, for his first appearance since November 2021! A lot has changed since our last conversation. After losing his right arm in a tragic bus accident in 2018, Rishi channeled his personal adversity into founding Symbionic, an assistive tech startup dedicated to building affordable, life-changing prosthetic devices. In this episode, we dive deep into the massive pivots the business h…
classificationReason: Focuses on engineering and scaling robotic prosthetic arms, including hardware design, R&D, user impact, and assistive-technology deployment.
qualityReason: Detailed founder interview covering product development, engineering challenges, company evolution, and real-world users.
